summary: TechCreate Group Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release responding to NYSE American's commencement of delisting proceedings. The exchange cited Section 1002(e) (other event provision) and Sections 1001/1003 of the NYSE American Company Guide. No specific price per share, premium, or board recommendation is provided. The company is evaluating options including an appeal. Mechanics involve suspension of trading pending delisting; no regulatory clock is specified. This is a non-US foreign private issuer filing; the US equivalent is a Form 8-K Item 3.01 (notice of delisting). Watch for any appeal outcome or potential going-private transaction.
